rows.humanReview: Confirm the source code list and whether this is a legal PWD registration type or a clinical diagnosis.
comparisons: pwd
Uses Patient.extension:pwdDisability.extension:disabilityType (CodeableConcept, extensible PH disability-type value set) for registration classification.
usProblem
A managed disability can be asserted as a problem Condition, but that is a clinical assertion, not the PWD registration category itself.
au
Profiles general clinical Condition.code; it does not prescribe a PWD registration field.
rows.terminologyNote: No row-specific SNOMED CT/LOINC concept is established from this source alone; use a governed value set when the actual diagnosis, finding or answer is known.
rows.policyBasis: NCDA Administrative Order No. 001, s. 2021 (PWD ID issuance); DOH AO No. 2013-0005 / -A / -B (Philippine Registry for Persons with Disabilities) (v4.0 form)

rows.policyGap: PH Core 0.2.0 ph-core-disability-type-vs carries only 9 codes and omits Mental Disability, Cancer and Rare Disease, and folds Deaf/Hard of Hearing into "hearing". The profile value set therefore does not yet cover the full PRPWD v4.0 national list.

rows.label: With Permanent Disability
rows.useCase: Record a legal/administrative permanence answer only after its meaning and extension are defined.
rows.recommendation: Document a PH Core Patient extension gap; do not derive permanence from a missing Condition.abatement.
rows.humanReview: Define “permanent,” who attests it, whether No differs from unknown, and whether it belongs in registration or a separate assessment.
comparisons: pwd
The PWD extension contains ID, disabilityType, expiry date and issuing LGU, but no permanence element.
usProblem
Clinical status and abatement concern a problem’s activity or resolution; they do not assert permanent disability.
au
A general Condition may carry abatement, but AU Core does not define a legal permanence flag.
rows.terminologyNote: No row-specific SNOMED CT/LOINC concept is established from this source alone; use a governed value set when the actual diagnosis, finding or answer is known.
rows.policyBasis: NCDA Administrative Order No. 001, s. 2021 (PWD ID issuance)
rows.policyOptions: Eligibility is limited to a person with a *permanent* disability; the policy does not enumerate a permanence value set, so the workbook’s Yes/No remains unbound.
rows.policyGap: Permanence is a registration precondition, not a coded element. No PH Core element or value set currently represents it.

rows.label: COVID-19
rows.definition: If the patient is a COVID-19 case or not.
rows.useCase: Record the explicit COVID-19 case-status answer, including a negative answer; a positive clinical diagnosis is a separate Condition.
rows.recommendation: Use Condition for an actual positive diagnosis; retain a question-coded answer for Yes/No or uncertain case status.
rows.humanReview: Is this a clinician diagnosis, surveillance case classification, or a binary screening answer? Define who makes the assertion and the allowed answers.
comparisons: usDx
Encounter Diagnosis can carry a confirmed COVID-19 diagnosis as Condition.code with encounter-diagnosis category.
au
General Condition supports disease assertions; its no-known-problems guidance does not represent a disease-specific Yes/No question.
r4
For checklist questions about absence of a disease, use Observation or QuestionnaireResponse rather than treating a missing Condition as No.
rows.terminologyNote: SNOMED CT 840539006 names confirmed COVID-19 disease, not the Yes/No case-status question; only use on a separately asserted diagnosis. https://docs.snomed.org/implementation-guides/snomed-ct-guide-for-covid-19/3-mapping-to-icd-10
rows.policyBasis: DOH AO No. 2020-0013 and DM No. 2024-0073 (COVID-19 case definitions and PDITR+)
rows.policyOptions: Case classification: Suspect; Probable; Confirmed. A person who does not meet a case definition is not a case (explicit negative).

Supports onset[x] for longitudinal problems and distinguishes onset from asserted/diagnosis date and recordedDate.
au
Supports Condition.onset[x] and specifically the dateTime choice when onset is known.

rows.policyOptions: Date of onset of the encounter-linked illness; not encounter start or record creation.

rows.label: Underlying Cause of Death (ICD-10)
rows.definition: Disease or injury that initiated the train of events leading directly to death
rows.useCase: Represent a coded underlying cause on a mortality Observation; select certifier-asserted versus manual/automated coding workflow before fixing the LOINC question code.
rows.recommendation: Use a proposed mortality Observation with Observation.code and Observation.valueCodeableConcept.coding for the ICD result; distinguish a certifier-authored cause from a subsequently coded underlying cause.
rows.humanReview: Is this the certifier-selected Part 1 cause or a manual/automated coded underlying cause? Who certifies it, and which Philippine ICD system/version applies?
comparisons: vrdr
Current VRDR Part 1 is an ordered, certifier-asserted Observation; its separately coded manual/automated underlying-cause Observations use different LOINC codes.
mdi
Current MDI Part 1 constrains the VRDR Observation and requires a certifier or data-absent reason.
usDx
Encounter Diagnosis category identifies a visit diagnosis, not an underlying certified cause of death.
rows.terminologyNote: VRDR 3.0.0: LOINC 69453-9 codes the certifier-authored Part I cause line; 80359-3 and 80358-5 code manually and automatically selected underlying causes respectively. The worksheet does not say which workflow produced its ICD-10 value. https://hl7.org/fhir/us/vrdr/StructureDefinition-vrdr-cause-of-death-part1.html
rows.policyBasis: DOH Administrative Order No. 2020-0008 (Rules on Medical Certification of Cause of Death); ICD-10 as adopted by DOH/PSA
rows.policyOptions: Certified cause per the ICD-10 medical certificate of cause of death: Part I causal sequence (line a immediate, lowest used line = underlying cause) and Part II contributing conditions; coded under ICD-10 selection rules.
rows.policyGap: The workbook does not state whether its ICD-10 value is the certified underlying cause (Part I) or a later manually/automatically assigned code. PSA codes certificates with Iris; those are different processing stages.

rows.label: Underlying Cause of Death Description
rows.useCase: Preserve the verbatim cause description on the corresponding mortality Observation, without treating text as a coded result or inventing a causal sequence.
rows.recommendation: Keep verbatim cause wording in Observation.valueCodeableConcept.text associated with the appropriate mortality assertion; reconcile it with the coded result and certificate context.
rows.humanReview: Is this verbatim certifier-authored wording or a code display? Can the source identify its causal line and corresponding code?
comparisons: vrdr
Current VRDR Cause of Death Part 1 carries the certifier’s original text in Observation.valueCodeableConcept.text, with line number as a component.
mdi
Current MDI Part 1 is an Observation derived from VRDR Part 1, not a generic death-status indicator.
au
Condition.code.text describes a diagnosis, but does not encode a certified mortality cause or its position in a chain.
rows.terminologyNote: LOINC 69453-9 identifies a US certificate Part I cause line, not generic mortality status. Keep certifier wording in Observation.valueCodeableConcept.text; establish whether this is paired with row 9 on the same line. https://hl7.org/fhir/us/mdi/StructureDefinition-Observation-mdi-cause-of-death-part1.html
rows.policyBasis: DOH Administrative Order No. 2020-0008 (Rules on Medical Certification of Cause of Death)
rows.policyOptions: Certifier’s own wording of the cause, based on best medical opinion and available records; duration/interval per condition.

rows.label: Date of Onset of Illness

rows.policyBasis: DOH Hospital Health Information Management Manual
rows.policyOptions: Onset is the date signs/symptoms first appeared; for COVID-19 surveillance the workbook cites the same operational definition.

rows.label: If Pregnancy - Induced Hypertension (Pre - Eclampsia)

rows.recommendation: Represent Yes/No/None as a question-coded Observation or QuestionnaireResponse; create a Condition only for an independently asserted positive diagnosis.
rows.humanReview: Does No/None include unknown? Is the question specifically pre-eclampsia, pregnancy-induced hypertension, or either?
comparisons: ipsPreg
Profiles Observation for pregnancy status; this is an analogy for recording a status answer, not a pre-eclampsia-specific profile.
usProblem
A clinically asserted pre-eclampsia problem can be Condition.code; the profile does not encode a Yes/No questionnaire answer.
r4
A checklist asserting absence of a condition belongs in Observation or QuestionnaireResponse, not a negative Condition by omission.

rows.policyOptions: Pregnancy-induced hypertension category (O10–O16); oedema/proteinuria in pregnancy, pre-eclampsia and eclampsia are distinct concepts.
rows.policyGap: The workbook’s label pairs PIH with pre-eclampsia. SNOMED CT 398254007 denotes pre-eclampsia only, which is narrower than all PIH.

rows.recommendation: Do not infer the indicator from a date comparison. Define a time-bounded registry assertion or a governed extension only after its meaning is settled.
rows.humanReview: New relative to first-ever diagnosis, current encounter, registration period, or reporting year? What are the values for unknown?
comparisons: usProblem
Separates onsetDateTime, assertedDate and recordedDate; none alone states “newly diagnosed” under a registry’s time-window rule.
au
General Condition supports dates, but defines no new-versus-previous diabetes flag.
rows.terminologyNote: No row-specific SNOMED CT/LOINC concept is established from this source alone; use a governed value set when the actual diagnosis, finding or answer is known.
rows.policyBasis: DOH AO No. 2013-0005 / -A / -B (Philippine Registry for Persons with Disabilities) (Diabetes Registry Form)
rows.policyOptions: Indicator: newly diagnosed or previously diagnosed diabetes.
rows.policyGap: The registry does not define the comparison window, so “newly” remains ambiguous.

rows.label: Type of Diabetes
rows.definition: Type of Diabetes as represented by a code.
rows.useCase: Capture a clinically supported type of diabetes with governed local terminology.
rows.recommendation: Represent the confirmed diabetes type in Condition.code; add a PH registry value set only if the use case requires limited, maintained choices.
rows.humanReview: Define type categories, national coding system and whether unspecified diabetes is allowed. E10-E14 is not a bound value set.
comparisons: usProblem
Uses Condition.code to identify a disease problem; no diabetes-type-only slice is mandated.
au
Binds general Condition.code to a national extensible clinical-condition set rather than an E10-E14-only subset.
rows.terminologyNote: E10–E14 is an ICD-10 range, not a single code. Code only an established diabetes type.
rows.policyBasis: DOH AO No. 2013-0005 / -A / -B (Philippine Registry for Persons with Disabilities) (Diabetes Registry Form)
rows.policyOptions: Type of diabetes; the workbook names ICD-10 E10–E14 as the example range, not a single code.

rows.section: DISEASE REGISTRY - CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE
rows.label: GOLD Classification
rows.useCase: Record a typed GOLD spirometric grade, preserving the classification edition and assessment.
rows.recommendation: If kept on the COPD Condition, use a stage repetition with type identifying spirometric grade; link assessment results when available.
rows.humanReview: Which GOLD edition, grade criteria, code system and assessment date are required?
comparisons: au
Retains base R4 Condition.stage.summary and .type without a GOLD-specific classification or binding.
mcode
Oncology staging uses specialized structures/Observations; it is an analogy for separating disease stage from its supporting assessment, not a COPD profile.
ph
Supports stage.summary and stage.type but defines no GOLD codes.
rows.terminologyNote: GOLD spirometric grade needs a governed grade and edition; do not treat the name of the scale as a patient result.
rows.policyBasis: DOH AO No. 2013-0005 / -A / -B (Philippine Registry for Persons with Disabilities) (COPD Registry Form); GOLD report
rows.policyOptions: GOLD spirometric grade; the classification edition must be stated because grades are edition-specific.

rows.section: DISEASE REGISTRY - CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE
rows.label: COPD Group
rows.useCase: Record a separate typed GOLD group under the same COPD Condition when clinically applicable.
rows.recommendation: Use a second typed stage repetition only if clinically and temporally tied to this COPD Condition; preserve the classification edition.
rows.humanReview: Was the recorded group ABCD or ABE, and were symptoms/exacerbations assessed at the same time as spirometry?
comparisons: au
Allows repeatable Condition.stage and .type through base R4, without a COPD group value set.
mcode
Shows why stage concepts and their assessments should be distinguished; it does not define GOLD ABCD/ABE groups.
rows.terminologyNote: GOLD ABCD and ABE are edition-dependent; select a versioned group scale before coding.
rows.policyBasis: DOH AO No. 2013-0005 / -A / -B (Philippine Registry for Persons with Disabilities) (COPD Registry Form); GOLD report
rows.policyOptions: COPD group; GOLD used ABCD before 2023 and ABE from the 2023 report, so the edition must be stated.

rows.section: DISEASE REGISTRY - CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE
rows.label: Pulmonary Tuberculosis
rows.definition: Does the patient have Pulmonary Tuberculosis?
rows.useCase: Record the explicit pulmonary-TB question answer separately from any verified TB diagnosis.
rows.recommendation: Use a question-coded answer for the source Yes/No; add a Condition for independently established pulmonary TB.
rows.humanReview: Is this a screening question, active confirmed TB, past TB, or suspected case? Confirm diagnostic status and code taxonomy.
comparisons: usDx
A positively diagnosed pulmonary TB can be a coded encounter Condition; the profile does not carry a binary screening answer.
au
Its no-known-conditions coding guidance addresses absence of problems generally, not this specific TB question.
r4
Checklist Yes/No answers can be Observation or QuestionnaireResponse; absence of a Condition is not an explicit No.
rows.terminologyNote: SNOMED CT 154283005 denotes pulmonary tuberculosis (disorder), not the question or an explicit negative result. https://evsexplore.semantics.cancer.gov/evsexplore/concept/snomedct_us/154283005
rows.policyBasis: DOH AO No. 2015-0024 (Integrated Tuberculosis Information System); DOH AO No. 2011-0010
rows.policyOptions: Pulmonary TB question answer; national TB guidance distinguishes bacteriologically confirmed, clinically diagnosed and not a TB case.
rows.policyGap: No public URL for AO 2015-0024 or AO 2011-0010 was verified, so none is linked.

rows.section: DISEASE REGISTRY - CHRONIC OBSTRUCTIVE PULMONARY DISEASE
rows.label: Basis for the final diagnosis of Asthma
rows.definition: Basis for the final diagnosis of Asthma
rows.useCase: Reference an actual supporting assessment from the asthma Condition; evidence.code is only appropriate when an evidence finding itself is supplied.
rows.recommendation: Attach coded evidence or references to the asthma Condition only for actual supporting findings, with clinical assessment details in their appropriate resources.
rows.humanReview: Does “basis” mean spirometry, clinician assessment, response to therapy, or a local checklist? Why is this asthma field under COPD?
comparisons: r4
Condition.evidence.code may describe the basis/manifestation; evidence.detail references supporting resources such as Observation or DiagnosticReport.
ph
Marks evidence.code Must Support but does not define asthma-specific evidence rules.
au
Retains the base evidence structure; it does not impose asthma diagnostic criteria.
rows.terminologyNote: No row-specific SNOMED CT/LOINC concept is established from this source alone; use a governed value set when the actual diagnosis, finding or answer is known.
rows.policyBasis: DOH AO No. 2013-0005 / -A / -B (Philippine Registry for Persons with Disabilities)
rows.policyOptions: Basis for the final diagnosis of asthma, captured as supporting evidence for the asthma problem.
